LALIT SABNANI, PMP
408-623-1710 | sabnani@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/lalitsabnani | Santa Clara, CA
SUMMARY
Hands-on, business-savvy Technical Leader and Senior Program Manager / Product Owner with extensive track record in semiconductor equipment, solar CPV manufacturing, and digital transformation. Expert in leading cross-functional teams across Alpha/Beta NPI lifecycles, material cost optimization (MCOS), global contract manufacturing, and AI/VR training systems. Meticulous execution driving multi-million dollar revenue growth, warranty reduction, and operational excellence.
Specialties
Technical Skill
Product, Project & Technical Program Management (TPM)
Materials Program Management & Clear-to-Build (CTB)
Supply Chain Optimization & Demand Planning
Strategic Supplier Negotiations & Contract Management
Quality Assurance, PFMEA & 8D Problem-Solving Methodology
Customer Satisfaction & Digital Transformation (AR/VR Systems)
Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment
Risk Management, Risk Mitigation & Market Red Teaming
Certifications: PMI-PMP (expired) / APICS-CPIM (expired)
Product Roadmap, PLM & Competitive Market Assessment
Agile (Scrum / Kanban) & Waterfall Methodologies
ERP / SAP (SAP BI, BOM Management, Inventory Control)
Data Analytics & Tools: SQL, Python, Tableau, Predictive Analytics
Financial Modeling, Costing (MCOS) & Purchase Price Variance
Business Process Development & Operational Continuous Improvement
Tools & Software: MS Office Suite, Open Source Tools, Unity / CAD 3D
TOP ACHIEVEMENTS
Product Innovation: Managed product development of complex, high-productivity ALD semiconductor equipment tool across Rev 0 and Rev 1 architectures in under 6 months.
Global NPI & Operations: Deployed Quality Function Deployment (QFD) & NPI at contract manufacturing sites in US and Malaysia, ramping CPV solar module production 9-fold in 9 weeks (yield improved from 35% to 87%).
Cost & Quality Impact: Reduced installation and warranty costs by $4M/year while elevating customer satisfaction metrics by 8%.
Reliability Improvement: Led failure reporting & corrective action (FRACAS) for Silicon Etcher, improving MTBF from 100 to >500 hrs and saving $1M/quarter.
Digital Transformation: Architected SAP BI Material Cost of Sales (MCOS) visibility system across global ERPs, driving purchase price variance accountability and gross margin optimization.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Applied Materials | Santa Clara, CA (Feb 2013 – Dec 2025)
Product Owner & Program Manager (12 Years)
• Product Owner – Serial Number Tracking System (2024–2025): Architected best-known-method (BKM) for end-to-end tracking of critical semiconductor OEM parts and modules from cradle to grave.
• Product Owner – Field Engineer & VR/AR Training Systems (2017–2024): Developed CAD-to-Unity interactive training platforms for global Customer Support Engineers, optimizing field readiness for 85% of shipped products.
• Program Manager – Red Team Competitive Strategy Testing (2017–2018): Established competitive simulation teams analyzing patent portfolios, roadmaps, and go-to-market strategies for CVD, PVD, and YTG product groups.
• Product Owner – Display & Flexible Technologies MCOS Project (2014–2016): Built SAP BI visibility framework across multiple ERPs to deliver accurate part quotes, invoice audits, and contract price compliance for engineering, sourcing, and finance.
• Program Manager – ALD Product Development (2013–2014): Led Alpha lifecycle product maturity, design reviews, and 1,000+ part procurement builds for high-productivity Atomic Layer Deposition tools.
Amonix | Seal Beach, CA (2010 – June 2012)
Program Manager / Quality Engineer (2 Years)
• Engineered startup expansion for Concentrated Photo Voltaic (CPV) mega module manufacturing from empty warehouse to full volume production in 9 weeks.
• Authored Manufacturing Control Plans, PFMEA, 8D methodologies, and Lean Six Sigma quality frameworks, increasing yield from 35% to 87%.
Strategic Confluence | San Jose, CA (2009 – 2010)
Principal / Partner (1 Year)
• Selected and implemented multi-site ERP systems for distributed memory manufacturing plants; advised cleantech and bioinformatics startups on business expansion.
Applied Materials Corp | Santa Clara, CA (1995 – 2009)
Technical Program Manager / Marketing & Operations Manager (14 Years)
• Senior Technical Program Manager (2006–2009): Drove NPI etch enhancement generating $200M revenue; solved silicon etcher micro-loading ($127M revenue); created super gas-panel saving $3.5M in R&D.
• Operations & FRACAS Manager (2003–2006): Managed $2M BLE budget across 7 programs for 95-person org; reduced non-compliance from 5.0 to 3.1 per tool; increased gross margin by $18M/quarter.
• Product Marketing Manager (2000–2003): Managed product lifecycle for 300mm eMax2000 Etcher (101 chambers shipped); named 2002 Best Product of the Year (BPOTY) by Semiconductor International.
EARLIER CAREER EXPERIENCE
Applied Materials (1995–2000): Engineering Manager & MTS – Led should-cost modeling saving $30k/tool, electrostatic chuck development, and ceramic dome erosion resolution (+16% MTBC).Micropolis Corp (1994–1995): Supply Chain Manager, RAID Subsystems & Video-on-Demand sourcing.Amperif / StorageTek (1984–1994): Manufacturing Engineering Manager – Managed materials, MRP software, and production scaling from 26 to 150 employees.
EDUCATION
MS in Industrial Engineering & Management – Arizona State University, Tempe, AZBS in Mechanical Engineering – M.S. University, Baroda, IndiaCertifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) | Lean Six Sigma Methods
KEY PUBLICATIONS
• “PV Module manufacturing: use of proven best practices for volume production” – EU PVSEC Barcelona, 2010
• “PV in the Micro-Grid Context: Concepts & Case Studies” – EU PVSEC 2011
• “Developing Market Opportunities for Flexible Rooftop PV Applications” – EU PVSEC 2011

cover_letters.content:
Dear Hiring Team at Apex Hardware Systems,

When leading complex operational transformations in high-growth organizations, real impact requires more than keeping systems running—it demands driving digital transformation, exercising clear product ownership, leveraging cutting-edge AI tools, and rallying cross-functional teams around a high-value vision.

As a strategic leader passionate about building and leading successful projects with deep expertise in digital transformation, product ownership/management, AI tool integration, and Program Management, Supply Chain Optimization, Materials Management, I was immediately drawn to the Senior Technical Program Manager position at Apex Hardware Systems. Throughout my career, I have specialized in turning intricate technical frameworks into streamlined digital solutions that deliver measurable ROI and operational agility.

Key Highlights & Strategic Capabilities I Bring:
- **Digital Transformation & Product Ownership**: Managed product life cycles from strategic roadmap definition to cross-functional deployment, cutting operational lead times by over 20% while building resilient, data-driven capabilities.
- **Project Leadership & Execution**: Passionate about building and leading high-performing cross-functional teams across engineering, materials management, and operations to deliver successful projects on time and on budget.
- **AI Tools & Workflow Innovation**: Hands-on experience deploying AI tools and automated analytical workflows to optimize decision-making, boost productivity, and drive continuous improvement.
- **Domain Strengths**: Hands-on proficiency in Technical Program Management, Program Management, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Cross-Functional Team Leadership.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my digital transformation expertise, AI tool experience, and passion for leading successful projects will accelerate strategic goals for Apex Hardware Systems.

Warm regards,

LALIT SABNANI, PMP
408-623-1710 | sabnani@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/lalitsabnani | Santa Clara, CA
